text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Greeting the Senior Year summer training 
camp under the blazing sun! As for Mejiro 
Ardan—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"—During this summer training camp, I'd 
like to surpass my limits at least a 
thousand times."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"However, it is true that I wish to push 
past my limits."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"It is an ideal opportunity to train 
rigorously in preparation for the Mainichi 
Okan."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The hot and passionate summer training 
camp begins once again!!
